narrative.overview:
The page is set the way an ML reader already trusts evidence: an arXiv preprint or conference camera-ready. One serif (STIX Two Text) carries every role, from the title to the table figures. One centred title block with an author line, an indented abstract with a run-in bold label, numbered sections and subsections, a booktabs results table with its caption above, and hyperref-style cross-references ("Table 1", "§1.1") that jump to their target and briefly tint it. The density is that of a paper: a single 42rem reading column, generous line height, no decoration that a typesetter would not use.

Depth, colour and shape are all nearly absent on purpose. White paper and near-black ink, one hyperlink blue, rules instead of boxes, square corners. Dark mode is the same paper in a darker stock: tokens swap values under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, the rules never change. There is no theme toggle; the page follows the system setting.

The world explicitly refuses the dev-portfolio template: no hero banner, no pill buttons, no cards, no chips or tags, no stat tiles, no shadows, no monospace.
keyCharacteristics: One family (STIX Two Text) at weights 400, 400 italic, 600, 600 italic; nothing else is loaded.
One reading column (42rem measure) with a sticky running head.
Numbered sections (1, 2, 3, 4) and subsections (1.1, 1.2) in lining figures, referenced from the text.
Booktabs table rules (1.5px top and bottom, 0.75px under the head, no verticals).
One accent: hyperlink blue, for links, cross-references, focus and selection only.
Flat: no shadows, no cards, 2px radius only where a tint or focus ring needs a corner.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Hyperlink Blue appears only where something can be followed or is focused: links, cross-references, focus rings, selection, and the landing tint. Never as a fill, heading colour, or decoration.

rules.name: The Same Grammar Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps the values of `--paper`, `--ink`, `--ink-soft`, `--rule`, `--hair`, `--link` and `--tint` and nothing else. No component has a dark-mode-only rule.

rules.name: The Lining Figures Rule
rules.body: Section numbers and table figures use `lining-nums tabular-nums` so columns compare digit by digit; section numbers sit 0.6em before their title (0.3em in the running head).

rules.name: The No Fake Small Caps Rule
rules.body: The fontsource latin subset has no true small caps, so none are used and none are synthesised. Labels are bold upright (sections, caption label, abstract label) or italic (meta leads, context, run-in heads) instead.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 600 exist, each with its italic. Never request 300, 500 or 700; the browser would synthesise them.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with horizontal rules (booktabs on the table, hairlines between subsections and under the running head), never with containers, backgrounds or shadows.

dos: **Do** set every role in STIX Two Text at 400 / 600 and their italics, with lining figures, and tabular figures wherever numbers are compared.
**Do** number sections and subsections and point at them from the text with cross-references that jump, focus and tint (tint removed under reduced motion).
**Do** draw results as booktabs tables: caption above, 1.5px top and bottom rules, 0.75px mid rule, right-aligned tabular figures.
**Do** keep all colour in the seven tokens and let dark mode swap only their values.
**Do** keep the 42rem single column with a 16px gutter, and give every `id` a 4rem scroll margin so it clears the running head.
donts: **Don't** use cards, pill buttons, chips or tags, stat tiles, or a hero banner.
**Don't** add shadows or background-filled containers; use rules.
**Don't** use monospace, even for repository paths or code names.
**Don't** fake small caps with `font-variant: small-caps` or uppercase-plus-tracking; the loaded subset has none.
**Don't** use Hyperlink Blue for anything that cannot be followed or focused.
**Don't** draw vertical rules or zebra stripes in tables.
